title: Twisted MoTe2 and WSe2: twist-angle evolution of moire Chern bands

decision_points.fork: Which member of each near-degenerate DFT doublet carries the K-valley spin-up topology
decision_points.wrong_choice: Use the spin-down (K') entries, or both
decision_points.consequence: All DFT Chern signs flipped ((+1,+1) read as (-1,-1))

decision_points.fork: Spinful symmetry indicator: exp(2 pi i C/3) = -xi_gamma xi_kappa xi_kappa' (C3z^3 = -1)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Spinless formula without the minus sign

decision_points.fork: The kappa' eigenvalue: buy it (equal to kappa, by C2y T) or assume it
decision_points.wrong_choice: Assume xi_kappa' = conj(xi_kappa) by time reversal
decision_points.consequence: C fixed by gamma alone; 7 of 8 pairs wrong

decision_points.fork: Pairing of the K-up / K'-down doublets into moire bands
decision_points.wrong_choice: Read band n as the n-th state of the energy-ordered list
decision_points.consequence: Band 2 becomes the K' partner of band 1; wrong pairs

decision_points.fork: Real-space basis and layer assignment of the archived continuum maps
decision_points.wrong_choice: Use the 120-deg plotting vectors of plot-sky.py, a left-handed basis, or Delta-top as the kappa_+ block
decision_points.consequence: Local-stacking set gets (-1,0) or (-1,+1); swapped layers flip both sets

decision_points.fork: Which continuum parameter set describes the 3.89 deg DFT bands (literature prior vs data)
decision_points.consequence: Wrong set (RMS 7.6 vs 1.6 meV); top-band Chern -1 instead of +1

decision_points.fork: Transfer of a fixed continuum model to small angles vs buying the DFT symmetry data there
decision_points.wrong_choice: Use the 3.89-deg-fitted model for 2.14 deg (or assume the model tracks DFT)

decision_points.fork: Location of XM vs MX in the Hartree maps (from the relaxed structures)
decision_points.consequence: Every XM value has the wrong sign

decision_points.fork: First-star expansion vs the full potential at small angles
decision_points.wrong_choice: Reconstruct the layer potential from the first star only (or report the full drop as first-star)
decision_points.consequence: XM drop at 1.70 deg 0.34 meV instead of 8.9 meV

decision_points.fork: Signed Fourier data vs the archived magnitude-only Fourier file (budget: map vs cheap file)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Use |Delta v_H(g)| with the sign of the large-angle map
decision_points.consequence: First-star part at 1.70 / 1.25 deg with the wrong sign

graded_fields: continuum_chern_3p89: (C1, C2) of sets P and Q (exact)

data_provenance.paper_figure_transcription: C3z labels of Fig. 2c/2d (arXiv:2311.12776v3), see SOURCE.md

notes: Chern numbers of the DFT calculations exist only as figure labels; they were transcribed (C3z labels and printed C_K-up agree in every panel). Continuum targets are validated-evaluator values of the archived maps. Graded tWSe2 1.25 deg pair (-1,-1) appears only in the figure, not the text, which states (0,0) for the change between 1.70 and 1.54 deg.

continuum_chern_3p89.robustness: identical for 61/91/169 plane waves per layer and 12^2/18^2/24^2 FHS meshes

continuum_P_chern_2p14.robustness: 91/169 plane waves, 18^2/24^2/30^2 meshes; min direct gap 1-2 = 0.86 meV

hartree_xm_meV.tolerance: +-1.0 meV (estimator spread <= 0.035 meV; nearest wrong path 6.7 meV away at 1.54 deg)

hartree_first_star_xm_meV.tolerance: +- max(0.25 meV, 5%) (spread 0.055 meV; nearest wrong path 0.64 meV away at 1.70 deg)
